_why: Single source of truth for WHO owns each strategy document, WHAT version it
is, AS OF WHEN its data is true, and WHETHER it may be published.
It exists because of the P0 truth-stop of 2026-08-04: four documents
published mutually inconsistent live-accuracy figures, three asserted
survivorship control that ALPHA_WORKFLOW.md Â§B2 measured open, and one cited
a kill switch living in a different repository. Every one of those was a
status a human typed into markdown with nothing able to contradict it.
tools/docs_gate.py reads this file and fails the build when a registered
document is missing metadata, when a root-level .md appears that is neither
registered nor exempt, and when a pre-survivorship-fix backtest is unlabelled.
VERSION CONVENTION. The major version encodes fitness to publish, so a
reader can tell from the number alone: 0.1.x = NOT AUTHORITATIVE (known to
contain contradicted claims), 0.2.x = FROZEN (banner applied, authority
retained), 1.x = cleared for external reading. Bump on material change.
DATA_AS_OF is the date of the most recent DATA the document's claims rest
on -- not the date the prose was edited. Documents citing the live record
_why_external_partials: Partials produced by a SIBLING generator, not by docs_gate.py. A generated
region in a document may only claim one of these names (or one from
`partials` above); any other name earns no exemption from the
live-accuracy check, even if a matching file is dropped into partials/ by
hand. Three sibling generators write here, and each owns its own drift
tools/controls_evidence.py (from the Go source) via `--inject` plus
Declaring a name here is NOT on its own an exemption. A region is exempt
only when partials/<name>.md also exists AND the document's region is
equal to it, so regenerate the partial and re-inject the document in ONE
block once and writes the same bytes to both. Declaring a name without
writing the file changes only the gate's failure message.
_why_allow: Each entry below was adjudicated against the actual line on 2026-08-04 and
kept only because the line states something OTHER than a claim about this
system's live accuracy. Every entry is scoped by line_contains, never to a
whole file, so a genuine claim appearing later in the same document still
fails the build. An entry without a `reason` suppresses nothing â€” the gate
enforces that, so this list cannot rot into a silent bypass.

no-hardcoded-live-accuracy.reason: States what world-class funds achieve (52-56%) in order to argue 80% is impossible. Industry context and a deflationary argument, not a claim about this system.
Uses a hypothetical 80% win rate to show win rate can be high while expectancy is negative. A counterexample, not a measured result.
States a TARGET range (53-56%) the document argues toward. A goal, not a live figure. If this ever becomes a claimed result it must move into the generated partial.

forbidden-claims.reason: Describes a guaranteed COST â€” a crossed spread is charged on every entry â€” which is the opposite of a promotional guarantee. The word is on the forbidden list because of return claims; this is a cost argument for using limit orders.
